description: This file defines the ProductImage entity class, which models product images within the sales management system. It includes fields for image metadata, associations with product entities, and image content handling.

classes.name: ProductImage
classes.description: Entity class representing a product image, with properties for image data, type, description, and associations to product and image descriptions.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Returns the filename or path of the product image.

methods.name: setProductImage
methods.description: Sets the filename or path of the product image.

methods.name: isDefaultImage
methods.description: Checks if this image is marked as the default image.

methods.name: setDefaultImage
methods.description: Marks this image as default or not.

methods.name: getImageType
methods.description: Returns the type/category of the image.

methods.name: setImageType
methods.description: Sets the type/category of the image.

methods.name: isImageCrop
methods.description: Checks if the image is marked for cropping.

methods.name: setImageCrop
methods.description: Sets whether the image should be cropped.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the image entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the image entity.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates the image with a Product.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for this image.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the descriptions for this image.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns the image data as InputStream.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets the image data from InputStream.
